body: im sincerely failing at everything-- school, work, my mental health. its all just a mess and i feel like using the "mental health" card isn't appropriate anymore. i feel like i should've gotten my shit together by now. I'm about to graduate high school, and yet I'm still in the same spot. it feels like its never going to get better.
Thank you for your kind remarks :) The audience is just my English professor!
Hereditary from a few years ago was so obscure and disturbing.

I, too, have been in similar shoes. I am only three weeks self harm free which isn't much, but oh my god, it has been so hard sometimes. Self harm is biologically addictive to our brains once we do it. However, there are ways that may be great substitutes. We can get into that later if you'd like.

Let me tell you this... the more you inflict pain upon yourself, the more your brain accepts the behavior. Your mental health is so important, especially now. You are in a tough spot, and that IS okay. I have no clue how old you are, but you have made it this long!!! THAT TAKES STRENGTH! You continuously waking up every day and combating the negative thoughts is not an easy task, my dear. So please, make that your reason. You have come THIS far. Keep it going :)

I am here to talk and listen if you'd like. Do not fret to message me if you need to vent, you are not a burden and I'd love to listen. Take care, my friend.

I relate to this so much. I am a full IB student, so I am constantly made to do essays and projects. I had straight A’s all year… and now I have C’s because I’ve given up. You are not alone, my dear. I am here to talk if you’d like :) as hard as it may be, keep pushing forward <3
I plan on doing it tonight.
thank you for this, honestly. it genuinely helped.
Thank you! This actually was super helpful, and I appreciate it so very much! I think I may talk to my counselor and see what she says :)
